atoms.text: Arthur now wants to take you around London to end the tour. Will you go around London with him?

instruction.text: Select London on the map to return there.
Arthur wants to know if you recognise London’s famous landmarks. Select the correct image.

hint.text: A landmark is a building or place that is easily recognisable. For example, it could be a huge tower, a statue or a mountain.
hint.label: Landmark

feedback.wrong: These are the Pyramids of Giza in Egypt.
feedback.correct: Buckingham Palace is the home of the ruling king or queen of the United Kingdom.

feedback.wrong: This is Stonehenge in Wiltshire, England.
feedback.correct: Big Ben is the name of the largest bell that rings from this famous clock tower. It is right next to the Houses of Parliament.

feedback.wrong: This is the Eiffel Tower in Paris, France.
feedback.correct: The London Eye was built in 2000 to celebrate the new millennium. It is one of the tallest observational wheels in the world.

feedback.wrong: This is the Statue of Liberty in New York, USA.
feedback.correct: Tower Bridge was built in the late 19th century. It is a special bridge that can open to let ships through!

atoms.a: “What is the name of the river that runs through London?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m6'>What is the name of the river that runs through London?</voice>

atoms.a: “What activity could we do in London?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m6'>What activity could we do in London?</voice>

feedback.end: London is home to many museums and art galleries: the British Museum, the National Gallery, the Natural History Museum and many more!
